brief: Changes the case of a text: capitals, small letters, first letter only, each word, or swapped, with Unicode rules.
detail: It is the case helper behind the case methods of stzString. Build one with new stzStringCaseChanger("text"). Each in-place verb (Uppercase, Lowercase, Capitalize, CapitalizeEachWord, ToggleCase, DecapitalizeFirst, SetCase) changes the text it holds and has a passive twin that returns the changed text (Uppercased, Lowercased, Capitalized, EachWordCapitalized, CaseToggled, FirstDecapitalized). Accents follow the letter, the German ß uppercases to SS, and scripts without case (Hebrew, Arabic, emoji) are left alone. Do not pass a stzString object you still need: the first in-place edit empties it. IsCapitalized only checks the first character.
